Thank you for your invoice. Before we can process it, we need to confirm a few details. Please could you check and confirm the following:

1. The invoice number (we read INV-2026-70022, but the scan was unclear).
2. The invoice date (we read 2025-11-22, but this also needs confirmation).
3. The total of 44500.53 NAD against purchase order PO-NPHOTOMILD.

If any details are incorrect, please send a corrected invoice. Once we have your confirmation, we will continue our review. Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
